questions.q:
How many of the following are lanthanides?
Uranium, praseodymium, erbium, gadolinium, curium, hafnium, osmium, iridium
questions.solution: Praseodymium \text{(Pr),} erbium $\left(\text{Er}\right)$ and gadolinium $\left(\text{Gd}\right)$ are lanthanoids.

questions.examName: Most Important Selected Qs for JEE Advanced
questions.q: How many $\text{Cr} - \text{O}$ bonds are equivalent in anion?
questions.solution: Six Cr-O bonds are equivalent due to resonance and two bridged Cr-O bonds are equivalent (no resonance).
